{{Quote|Nibsy, give me two more specials. Hey, hey, hey! Not too much, not too much. You're always overfillin' it.|The fry cook|<ref name="Way Way Out" />}}
'''Nibsy''' was an [[Ubdurian]] individual who worked alongside a [[Unidentified fry cook|fry cook]] in a stall on [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Way Way Out" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> Nibsy served two helpings of the stall's [[Unidentified noodle dish (Port Borgo)|daily special]] to the [[Youngling|children]] [[Wim]] and [[Neel]]. The fry cook criticized Nibsy for filling the bowls with too many [[noodle]]s.<ref name="Way Way Out" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nibsy appeared in the "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Way Way Out" />
